cohort: The cohort consisted of 493 women who gave birth in facilities in Luxembourg between March 1, 2020, and July 1, 2021.
finding: Despite an overall high reported Quality of Maternal and Newborn Care (QMNC) in Luxembourg, improvements are needed in specific aspects of care and communication related to maternal autonomy, respect, and support.
mod_finding: 42.9% of women reported not being asked for consent prior to instrumental vaginal birth, and 20% did not receive information on the newborn after cesarean.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between March 1, 2020, and July 1, 2021, around the time of childbirth and discharge.
